messages:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up 12h until EchoMed pilot. Theyre focused on clinician triage flows with a lot of short-turn edits. Need a concise, customer-facing runbook that covers prefill, batching windows, adaptive quantization, streaming UX, and renewal/alert triggers. Draft below.
Jon (SRE): Thx. Key ops constraints: tight budget, desire for instant UX, unpredictable demo bursts. Prioritize cost caps + graceful degradation.
Aria (AE): Renewal hinge: conversion from trial -> paid depends on cost/consult. Finance asked for early-warning emails if spend outpaces forecast by 25% over a 48h window.
Lee (DevEx): UX recs: streaming with chunked incrementals, explicit confirm endpoint to avoid double-apply, client debounce 200-350ms. Also recommend client coalescing identical edits.
Maya (CS): Customer-facing runbook (one pager):
- Prefill: we will prefill top 12 clinician templates via prefill API. Keep template bodies <220 tokens for cacheability.
- Warmup: reserve 1x GPU warm pool for first 72h and run 40 scripted warm sessions pre-launch.
- Streaming: enable chunked streaming; render partials; client must call /accept when user confirms final text.
- Debounce & coalesce: client debounce 250ms; collapse rapid identical edits to avoid token storms.
- Cache: prefix-cache for system+template prompts. Stable key = hexsha(tenant|template_id|normalized_prefix). TTL = 9h. Avoid volatile session IDs.
- Batching windows: set continuous batching max_delay_ms = 12ms for interactive flows. For background bulk inference, use batch_delay_ms = 80ms.
- Adaptive quantization: enable dynamic quantize-on-fallback (q4 -> q3) when util > 70% or p95 > 900ms for 3m. Prefer *gradual* switch (10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%) to measure quality impact.
- Cost guardrails: session token cap = 14k; daily account cap = $380. AE + customer exec notified at 120% forecast.
- Telemetry: emit token_count, model_variant, latency_ms, cache_hit, batch_size, and user_action. Tag telemetry with journey_id.
- Renewal/alerts: weekly health digest + 48h early-warning if spend > 125% of forecast. If 3-day rolling avg cost/session > target by 30% -> AE schedules cost review with CS + SRE.
- Escalation: oncall SRE, EngOps lead, AE contact block in Confluence runbook.
Jon (SRE): Ops snippet for EngOps automation (put in Confluence ops doc):
```json
{
  "tenant": "echomed",
  "warm_pool": {"gpus": 1, "duration": "72h"},
  "cache": {"strategy": "prefix", "ttl_seconds": 32400, "key_algo": "hexsha"},
  "batching": {"interactive_max_delay_ms": 12, "bulk_max_delay_ms": 80},
  "guards": {"session_token_cap": 14000, "daily_cost_cap_usd": 380},
  "fallback_policy": {
    "triggers": [
      {"metric": "util_pct", "op": ">=", "value": 70, "window_sec": 180},
      {"metric": "p95_latency_ms", "op": ">", "value": 900, "window_sec": 180}
    ],
    "actions": [
      {"type": "gradual_model_switch", "target": "gpt-q3-small", "steps": [10,50,100], "step_window_sec": 300},
      {"type": "reduce_batch", "factor": 0.5}
    ]
  }
}
```
Lee (DevEx): Also note: for streaming safety, require a short handshake header with session metadata and include a seq_id for chunk ordering. Recommend chunk size ~64 tokens for smooth UX.
Aria (AE): For renewal-risk metrics add conversion signal: if trial conversion rate falls below expected AND cost/session > target for 7 consecutive days, trigger "renewal at-risk" workflow.
Maya (CS): Customer materials to publish: one-page PDF for customer, Confluence ops doc with full snippets and rollback steps, and AE email templates (cost alert + renewal outreach). Ill draft the templates and tag this thread.
runbook-bot: Runbook published: /cs-runbooks/echomed-batching-quantize-streaming-onepager - https://confluence.internal/echomed-runbook
Jon (SRE): Ill add the kubectl rollback snippet and manual failover CLI in the ops doc.
Maya (CS): Thanks team 1 will finalize after the pre-launch sync and post the final PDF here for easy access.
